user.title: Thermal zone
user.description: ATHB creates one Home Assistant device per thermal zone. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md)

data_description.name: Recognisable room or zone name used for the device and its entities.

environment.title: Room measurements
environment.description: Select the environmental inputs. Outdoor humidity is not used: adaptation depends on outdoor temperature history, while comfort and surface risk use indoor humidity. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#environmental-inputs)

data_description.primary_temperature: Representative room-air temperature. Invalid or stale input is never replaced with a plausible value.
data_description.rh_mode: Measured uses an entity; Declared uses a fixed percentage with declared provenance.
data_description.outdoor_source: Temperature source used to build the persisted seven-day running mean.

humidity.title: Indoor humidity
humidity.description: Only the input required by the selected humidity mode is shown. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#environmental-inputs)

data_description.rh_entity: Entity reporting indoor RH in percent.
data_description.rh_declared: Fixed indoor RH from 0 to 100%, explicitly tagged as declared.

targets.title: Climate targets
targets.description: Select one through eight climates. ATHB only sends temperature targets and never changes HVAC mode, power, fan, preset, swing or humidity. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#climate-targets)

data_description.targets: Thermostats whose supported temperature endpoint ATHB may manage.

preferences.title: Comfort and model choices
preferences.description: Balanced with the standard room model is the recommended start. The comfort level directly selects a sensation-space target; occupancy can independently apply a setback. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#comfort-level-occupancy-and-boost)

data_description.comfort_strategy: Energy-to-comfort level solved directly in ATHB sensation space; temperatures are never interpolated.
data_description.radiant_model: Standard is suitable for normal rooms. Mold Indicator reads its calculated critical-point attribute for surface-risk diagnostics.
data_description.advanced_settings: Walk through scientific assumptions, comfort bounds, command safety and local-air points.
data_description.occupancy_entity: Optional binary occupancy or schedule source. Off applies the selected setback; on applies none.

setback.title: Unoccupied setback
setback.description: This setback is applied only while the selected occupancy source is off, regardless of comfort level. Boost temporarily bypasses it. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#comfort-level-occupancy-and-boost)

data_description.eco_intensity: Max uses the command limits; Eco subtracts/adds 4 °C; Comfort uses 2 °C; Custom exposes both offsets.

radiant.title: Mold Indicator
radiant.description: Select the existing Home Assistant Mold Indicator. ATHB reads its estimated critical-point attribute directly; no template sensor is needed. The cold point is used for surface-risk diagnostics and is not treated as room MRT. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#radiant-and-surface-models)

data_description.mold_indicator_entity: A Home Assistant Mold Indicator entity containing the estimated_critical_temp attribute.

advanced_model.title: Human and air-movement model
advanced_model.description: These assumptions directly affect the ATHB heat-balance sensation. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#human-and-air-movement-model)

data_description.met: Metabolic rate; 1 met = 58.15 W/m² and seated light work is about 1.1 met.
data_description.clothing_mode: Automatic derives adaptive clothing; Fixed uses a declared clo value.
data_description.air_speed_mode: Fixed uses declared m/s; Measured requires a valid entity.

clothing.title: Fixed clothing insulation
clothing.description: Use for a stable, known clothing ensemble. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#human-and-air-movement-model)

air_speed.title: Air speed
air_speed.description: Only the selected source is shown. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#human-and-air-movement-model)

data_description.air_speed_m_s: Fixed room air speed in m/s.
data_description.air_speed_entity: Entity in m/s; invalid or stale data blocks calculation instead of being replaced.

comfort_parameters.title: Comfort and adaptation bounds
comfort_parameters.description: Expert sensation and weather-memory values; these are not thermostat temperatures. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#comfort-and-adaptation-bounds)

data_description.lower_comfort_vote: Cold-side sensation boundary; more negative widens the cold side.
data_description.upper_comfort_vote: Warm-side sensation boundary; more positive widens the warm side.
data_description.running_mean_alpha: Exponential weight α; higher values retain older weather longer.
data_description.reject_extrapolation: Suppress roots outside ATHB 2022 applicability instead of flagging extrapolation.

setback_parameters.title: Custom unoccupied setback
setback_parameters.description: The offsets widen the solved heating and cooling targets only while unoccupied. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#comfort-level-occupancy-and-boost)

data_description.eco_heating_setback_c: Degrees subtracted from the solved heating target while unoccupied.
data_description.eco_cooling_setback_c: Degrees added to the solved cooling target while unoccupied.

control_limits.title: Everyday control settings
control_limits.description: Set the normal safety limits, manual-override time and Boost behaviour. ATHB automatically interprets unambiguous climate Auto capabilities and never changes HVAC mode. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#everyday-control-settings)

data_description.minimum_control_temperature: Lowest °C request before intersecting device bounds; also used by Max setback and Rapid cooling.
data_description.maximum_control_temperature: Highest °C request before intersecting device bounds; also used by Max setback and Rapid heating.
data_description.manual_override_minutes: Write suppression after an external target change, unless Resume is pressed.
data_description.boost_delta_c: Adaptive Boost target shift toward thermal neutral. Rapid drives at the command limit until this target is reached.
data_description.boost_duration_minutes: Maximum time before Boost automatically returns to Off.

command_behavior.title: Command normalization and fallback
command_behavior.description: Expert inward rounding, redundant-write and missing-history controls. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#command-normalization-and-fallback)

data_description.minimum_range_gap: Required distance between heating and cooling in an atomic range command.
data_description.feedback_resolution: Tolerance comparing target feedback with the last ATHB command.
data_description.fallback_mode: Fixed uses declared targets; No write waits for qualified history.

fallback_temperatures.title: Fallback and safety temperatures
fallback_temperatures.description: Used for insufficient outdoor history when Fixed is selected, and to withdraw stale heating or cooling demand after one hour without a fresh room-temperature report. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#stale-measurement-safety)

data_description.fallback_heating_c: Bounded heating safety target; it may only reduce an existing stale heating demand.
data_description.fallback_cooling_c: Bounded cooling safety target; it may only reduce an existing stale cooling demand and must exceed the heating fallback.

critical_locations.title: Critical local-air locations
critical_locations.description: Add up to eight local-air points. Zero disables this feature. They use the selected strategy vote and bounded directional influence. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#critical-local-air-locations)

data_description.critical_location_count: Number of conditional local-air pages that follow.

critical_location.title: Critical location {number} of {total}
critical_location.description: Configure one separately measured local-air point. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#critical-local-air-locations)

data_description.location_id: Stable unique label such as window_seat.
data_description.location_mode: Monitoring does not constrain; Heating, Cooling or Both only affect selected directions.
data_description.location_entity: Local air temperature, not surface temperature or MRT.

source_freshness.title: Measurement freshness
source_freshness.description: How long ATHB may trust the last Home Assistant report from each selected measured source. Increase this only for sensors that legitimately report slowly; expired calculations remain visible but are explicitly marked stale and cannot drive normal control. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#measurement-freshness)

data_description.primary_temperature_freshness_minutes: Maximum age of the room-temperature entity report; 30 minutes is the safe default.
data_description.relative_humidity_freshness_minutes: Maximum age of measured indoor-RH reports.
data_description.local_temperature_freshness_minutes: Maximum report age for configured critical local-air points.
data_description.radiant_freshness_minutes: Maximum report age for measured MRT, globe or surface temperature.
data_description.air_speed_freshness_minutes: Maximum report age for measured air speed.

target_calibration.title: Target calibration {number} of {total}
target_calibration.description: Actuator offset for `{target}`, not a room-sensor correction. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#target-calibration)

review.title: Review thermal zone
review.description:
**{zone}** will use `{primary}` and `{outdoor}` with {target_count} target(s). Strategy: **{strategy}**.

ATHB creates one zone device. Control starts **off** for a new zone until you enable it.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure thermal zone
reconfigure.description: This repeats every setup choice while retaining the same zone identity and device. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md)

data_description.name: Update the displayed zone and device name.

error.invalid_rh_source: Select exactly one valid humidity source.
error.invalid_targets: Select one through eight distinct climate targets.
error.target_not_registered: Every climate target must have an entity-registry identity.
error.target_already_controlled: Another enabled ATHB zone already controls this target.
error.invalid_control_bounds: The minimum must be below the maximum.
error.invalid_option: One or more options are outside their supported range.
error.duplicate_location: Use a non-empty, unique location label.

abort.reconfigure_successful: The thermal zone configuration was updated successfully.

init.title: ATHB settings
init.description: Choose the part of this thermal zone you want to change. Every setup choice is available here; only the selected section is shown.

sources.title: Room and measurement sources
sources.description: Change the room name and the entities used for indoor temperature, indoor humidity and outdoor history. Replacing a source never fabricates a fresh measurement. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#environmental-inputs)

data_description.name: Displayed name of the ATHB device.
data_description.primary_temperature: Representative room-air temperature; choose a source that reports often enough for its freshness limit.
data_description.rh_mode: Measured uses an entity; Declared uses a fixed percentage with declared provenance.
data_description.outdoor_source: Temperature source used to build the persisted seven-day running mean.

source_humidity.title: Indoor humidity
source_humidity.description: Only the input required by the selected humidity mode is shown. Outdoor humidity is not used. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#environmental-inputs)

data_description.rh_entity: Entity reporting indoor relative humidity in percent.
data_description.rh_declared: Fixed indoor relative humidity from 0 to 100%, explicitly tagged as declared.

target_entities.title: Controlled climate entities
target_entities.description: Select one through eight climate entities. ATHB writes temperature targets only and never changes HVAC mode, power, fan, preset, swing or humidity. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#climate-targets)

data_description.targets: Climate entities whose supported temperature endpoint ATHB may manage. Select RoomMind's override climate when RoomMind must remain the demand controller.

comfort.title: Comfort, occupancy and control
comfort.description: Change comfort level, optional occupancy/setback, room model and everyday command limits. Enable advanced settings only for scientific assumptions and technical safety controls. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md)

data_description.comfort_strategy: Energy-to-comfort target solved directly in ATHB sensation space.
data_description.radiant_model: Standard is recommended; Mold Indicator adds cold-surface diagnostics.
data_description.advanced_settings: Open all expert settings in short conditional pages.
data_description.occupancy_entity: Optional binary occupancy or schedule source; off applies setback. Do not use a heating-demand or thermostat-idle output as occupancy.

setback.title: Unoccupied setback
setback.description: Shown only because an occupancy source is configured. It applies whenever that source is off. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#comfort-level-occupancy-and-boost)

data_description.eco_intensity: Choose maximum, 4 °C, 2 °C or custom widening while unoccupied.

radiant.title: Mold Indicator
radiant.description: Select the existing Home Assistant Mold Indicator. ATHB reads estimated_critical_temp directly; no template sensor is needed. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#radiant-and-surface-models)

data_description.mold_indicator_entity: Existing Mold Indicator whose calculated critical point is used for surface-risk diagnostics.

data_description.air_speed_entity: Measured m/s; invalid input blocks calculation.

setback_parameters.title: Custom unoccupied setback
setback_parameters.description: Custom offsets applied after sensation-space solving, only while unoccupied. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#comfort-level-occupancy-and-boost)

control_limits.title: Everyday control settings
control_limits.description: Normal limits, override time and Boost behaviour. Auto capabilities are interpreted automatically when unambiguous. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#everyday-control-settings)

data_description.minimum_control_temperature: Lowest ATHB request and Max heating setback.
data_description.maximum_control_temperature: Highest ATHB request and Max cooling setback.

command_behavior.title: Command normalization and fallback
command_behavior.description: Expert rounding, feedback and history controls. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#command-normalization-and-fallback)

fallback_temperatures.title: Fallback and safety temperatures
fallback_temperatures.description: Used for insufficient outdoor history when Fixed is selected and as a one-hour stale-input de-escalation limit. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#stale-measurement-safety)

data_description.fallback_heating_c: Bounded heating safety target that can only lower stale demand.
data_description.fallback_cooling_c: Bounded cooling safety target that can only raise a stale cooling setpoint.

critical_locations.title: Critical local-air locations
critical_locations.description: Zero through eight separate local-air points. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#critical-local-air-locations)

data_description.location_entity: Local air, not surface or MRT.

source_freshness.title: Measurement freshness
source_freshness.description: Maximum accepted age of the latest Home Assistant report. Only selected measured source types are shown. [Technical reference](https://github.com/Patrick1610/Adaptive-Thermal-Heat-Balance/blob/main/docs/configuration-reference.md#measurement-freshness)

state.rapid: Rapid — maximum drive, then hold target

removed_source_or_target.title: ATHB source or target was removed
removed_source_or_target.description: Reconfigure the zone and select an available source or target.

duplicate_target_ownership.title: Climate target is controlled by two ATHB zones
duplicate_target_ownership.description: Disable one zone or select a different target.

corrupt_control_storage.title: ATHB control recovery data is corrupt
corrupt_control_storage.description: Review the zone and press Resume before enabling commands.

persistent_target_rejection.title: Climate target repeatedly rejected ATHB commands
persistent_target_rejection.description: Check the target capability, bounds and grid.

incompatible_auto_mapping.title: Automatic HVAC mode is ambiguous for ATHB
incompatible_auto_mapping.description: ATHB could not infer heating or cooling from this climate's public scalar capabilities. Select a concrete supported HVAC mode on the climate device.

missing_history_24h.title: ATHB outdoor history remains unavailable
missing_history_24h.description: Check the outdoor source and Recorder availability.

mandatory_input_unavailable_1h.title: A mandatory ATHB input remains unavailable
mandatory_input_unavailable_1h.description: Restore the selected temperature or humidity source.
